messages:
devin: UX hiccup from the usage tests: sparklines in the compact rows lose context when we abbreviate units. users thought 1.2k meant 1.2k requests per second but the chart scale was actually per-minute. we should show unit labels more clearly.
leila: agree. proposal: append a small unit suffix next to the sparkline (e.g. "/m" or "/s") and include an accessible label that reads full unit (aria-label="Requests per minute"). keeps the compact look but clarifies meaning.
omar: about abbreviations: avoid fractional compact for values < 1000 (so show 500 not 0.5k). for larger numbers use one decimal max (12.3k). tooltip always shows full value + unit.
zack: smoothing: call it "Trend smoothing" and default OFF. for sparklines we should expose a per-row quick toggle (icon only) with aria-label and tooltip. toggling should not change data export.
a11y-bot: a11y notes: icon-only toggles must have accessible name, keyboard focusable, and update a polite live region: "Trend smoothing enabled for row X". also ensure unit suffixes are not aria-hidden if they convey semantic meaning.
devin: outlier handling idea: let users collapse the top 2% for sparklines as a temporary view (show clipped badge). but don't auto-apply. menu: "Show full / Clip top 2% / Annotate outliers". when clipped show dashed cap and tooltip: "Clipped at 98th percentile; highest value was 83,200 /m".
leila: microcopy for the clipped badge: small text "spikes clipped" with hover text "Click to see full range". keep badge minimal so it doesn't distract.
omar: tick density: in tiny sparklines hide numeric ticks entirely and only show a single end label if needed (left = baseline, right = latest) in compact mode. this reduces clutter.
zack: legend behavior: for stacked small charts, collapse legend into a single compact row with color dots 6px and label overflow handled with ellipsis; clicking expands inline. ensure 44px hit target via padding.
a11y-bot: contrast check: 6px tokens plus text must still meet AA. if color-only distinction used, also provide pattern/shape fallback for colorblind mode.
devin: quick example formatting helper to share:
```
function formatCompact(v, locale) {
  const abs = Math.abs(v);
  if (abs < 1000) return v.toLocaleString();
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1}).format(v);
}
```
leila: +1. please include unit in tooltip: e.g. "12.3k /m → 12,300 /m". zack please add specs to Figma (marker sizes, badge placement, iconography).
zack: will do. I'll make a small mock and drop it in ticket D-1270. can someone on a11y review after?
a11y-bot: I'll post the checklist in the ticket. remember: live region messages, focus order, and aria-labels for unit + clipped state.
devin: awesome. thanks team — main decisions: no fractional compact <1k, per-row smoothing toggle (default off), explicit clip opt-in with badge, unit suffix visible + aria-label, compact legend with accessible hit targets. filing follow-up task.
